versions.changelog:
Initial release of xhs-look-note-guaikei.

- Provides command-line tools to search, view, and analyze public Xiaohongshu notes and creators.
- Supports keyword searches with flexible filters, note detail viewing, comment extraction, and creator post monitoring.
- Returns structured note lists, interaction data, and comments for downstream analysis.
- Only works with public Xiaohongshu data; requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Designed for content research, trending topic discovery, KOL evaluation, and competitive analysis scenarios.
